=== app/app.go ===
package app

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/m/lib"
	"example.com/m/util"
)

// Run prints things.
func Run() {
	w := util.Widget{N: 1}
	fmt.Println(lib.Foo(), util.Util(), w.Double())
}

=== go.mod ===
module example.com/m

go 1.21

=== lib/lib.go ===
package lib

import "example.com/m/util"

// Foo returns a greeting.
func Foo() string { return helper() + util.Util() }

func helper() string { return "hi" }

=== util/util.go ===
package util

import "strings"

// Util upper-cases.
func Util() string { return strings.ToUpper("x") }

// Widget doubles.
type Widget struct{ N int }

func (w Widget) Double() int { return w.N * 2 }
